lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Necropolis DMV. Halfway point of our journey, hero. The dead need licenses to haunt, and the line predates several gods.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What do WE need?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: A Class-H Heroism License. Ours expired in chapter three. We've been adventuring ILLEGALLY, hero. I haven't slept.

lines.speaker: Registrar
lines.text: NAME?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: You have it on file. You just said you have everything on file.

lines.speaker: Registrar
lines.text: THE FILE MUST BE CONFIRMED. VERBALLY. WITH YOUR EMBARRASSING MIDDLE NAME.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: ...draw your weapon.
Window 1. The number board flickers: NOW SERVING 4,000,001. It is your number. It has been 6,000 years.

lines.speaker: The Lich Clerk
lines.text: NEXT.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: That's us! THAT'S US! Hero, I've never been so happy and so terrified!

lines.speaker: The Lich Clerk
lines.text: YOUR FORMS ARE... adequate. UNFORTUNATELY, THE SYSTEM IS DOWN. COMBAT IS THE BACKUP SYSTEM.

lines.speaker: The Lich Clerk
lines.text: Processed... approved... laminated...
A fresh Class-H Heroism License materializes. The photo is terrible. It is perfect.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: WE'RE LEGAL! Hero, we're LEGAL! ...why is the license already expiring in chapter twenty?
In the eternal queue, skeletons pass around pamphlets printed on rice paper.

lines.speaker: Queue Skeleton
lines.text: It says here... we don't HAVE to hold our place in line... for six centuries... without breaks?

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: Local 4,000,001 — the Undead Line-Standers' Guild. First demand: CHAIRS.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He's here too. Of course he's here too.
A phantom vehicle idles in the testing yard. It has no wheels, no doors, and one furious instructor.

lines.speaker: Road Test Revenant
lines.text: MIRRORS. SIGNAL. SCREAM. In that order. BEGIN.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: This isn't a road.

lines.speaker: Road Test Revenant
lines.text: THE ROAD IS A STATE OF MIND. YOU HAVE ALREADY FAILED IT.
PING. The number board changes: NOW SERVING 4,000,001. The queue holds its collective breath. All of it. Every bone.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: That's us, hero. Six thousand years of waiting ends TODAY. Straighten your collar. Practice your embarrassing middle name.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Never.
